fieldValues.title: The owner's strategy is held, but as suggestions nothing reads
fieldValues.summary: The editor group's stance for its next cycle, Thunder (Act, Stabilise, Zoom out), set by the owner on 2026-10-24 (vignette f71456d5), survives as three agent-created principles and three axes in the group's domain. The clerk reads only affirmed records, the affirmation surface (srs-web#617) is not built and is blocked, and nothing that orders work reads a stance. So each time it looks lost.
fieldValues.body:
- Thunder: principles 0e2a00e2, 1997e9d5, f93a7b24 (lean toward Act, Stabilise, Zoom out; derived-from f71456d5), axes 16000f1b, d3777c50, f194112a; all createdBy ai, in Suggestions.
- clerk domains shows every pole of both groups' tensions as '?'.
- The same loss happened to the owner's axis placements and was restored on 2026-10-25 (srs-programme#256); clerk#192 is still open.
- clerk#194 (record an owner ruling as the owner's act) was closed as superseded by the ruling that affirmation never happens in chat (clerk#197 R2), which leaves the owner's stance waiting for srs-web#617.
- Ratified 2026-10-16: 6494df0f (a member's stance comes from an archetype), ee95817b (a stance is read relative to its boundary).
- No stance has been set for WG Third-party ready.
- No record binds a stance to a group and a cycle; topup and the routine briefs never read one.
